## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Reproducibility impact

Describe any effect on schemas, deterministic outputs, datasets, metrics,
cohorts, or stored artifacts. Write "none" when there is no effect.

## Validation

- [ ] `uv run --frozen python scripts/quality.py`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has automated tests.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or restricted source files are included.
- [ ] Documentation and manifests are updated when contracts changed.
